name: Worktrees
description: Git worktrees of the added repositories, and the selectors that name them.

repo.description: A repo selector: id:, name: or path:, or a bare ID or name.

group.description: A group ID or exact name: its folder workspaces.

branch.description: Short branch name, or null when HEAD is detached or the workspace is a folder.

parentId.description: The workspace this one is nested under, or null.

baseRef.description: The ref the branch was cut from, or null when unknown.

groupId.description: The group whose parent folder the workspace sits on, or null.

projectGroupId.description: The display-only project-group membership, or null.

manualOrder.description: Persistent sibling order; higher values render first in Manual sort.

sleeping.description: Reversible visibility state; setting it never terminates a session.

sleepChangedAt.description: The last sleep or wake timestamp, or null before the first change.

archivedAt.description: Archive timestamp, or null if the workspace is active.

volatile.description: Actual volatile-context evidence, or null when unavailable.

remoteConnected.description: Actual remote connectivity evidence, or null when unavailable.

automationProvenance.description: Immutable automation and run snapshots; absent for ordinary and pre-migration workspaces.

linkedPR.description: Linked GitHub pull request; absent when unlinked.

linkedIssue.description: Linked GitHub issue; absent when unlinked.

pushTarget.description: The configured remote and head branch used for pushes; absent without a PR push target.

method.description: Caller-relative durable creation evidence for each current workspace instance. Known desktop clients and paired phones are compared only to a matching authenticated caller; unknown historical and external origins remain null.

automation.description: True only for validated immutable live-dispatch automationProvenance on this filesystem instance; false for known ordinary creation; null when no creation evidence is available.

otherClient.description: True or false only for a known authenticated UI-installation comparison or the existing paired-phone comparison; null for unknown and cross-origin creators. Only the comparison is exposed, never a client ID or machine identity.

method.description: List only authenticated remote peers from quirky.orchestration and recheck each exact pairing revision and fingerprint. Local execution is not represented as a fabricated host row.

repo.description: A repo selector: id:, name: or path:, or a bare ID or name. Without repo or group the caller's own project is used.

group.description: A group ID or exact name: creates a folder workspace on its parent folder.

requireGitRepository.description: Refuse folder and group targets before mutation; owner-runtime creation requires a genuine Git repository.

host.description: Exact authenticated peer ID, never a label. A mobile or federation peer is not owner-cli authority and does not authorize remote worktree creation.

name.description: Sanitised folder name; blank or absent uses the GitHub title when sourced from GitHub, otherwise a generated name or the existing branch name.

branch.description: Existing local or remote branch to check out; GitHub issues and PRs do not accept this field.

branchName.description: New branch name instead of <prefix>/<name>; allowed for GitHub issues but not pull requests.

base.description: Base for a new branch; GitHub issues may override it, while pull requests use their selected base branch and reject this override.

github.description: Fresh GitHub issue/PR source (#number or HTTPS work-item URL); requires a Git project and cannot be combined with branch, branchName, or a PR base override.

issueCommand.description: Run (default) or skip the configured command for an issue source.

trustIssueCommand.description: Trust the selected commit's shared issue command for this creation only.

trustIssueCommandHash.description: Pin one-time issue-command consent to the shared script hash shown by hooks-untrusted; use with trustIssueCommand.

trustSetupHash.description: Pin one-time setup consent to the shared script hash shown by hooks-untrusted; use with trustSetup.

displayName.description: Explicit label; otherwise a GitHub source title is used.

comment.description: Note; defaults to PR #N — TITLE or Issue #N — TITLE for GitHub sources. An explicit empty string clears it.

parent.description: A worktree selector for the workspace to nest the new one under; default: the caller's own worktree.

noParent.description: Do not nest the new worktree under the caller's worktree.

setup.description: Whether to run the project's setup script: run, skip, or inherit the project's policy (default).

trustSetup.description: Run a shared setup script that has not been trusted, this once.

agent.description: An agent ID (any but shell) to start in the new worktree once it exists, after setup when the project says to wait.

submitPrompt.description: Whether to press Enter after an initial prompt. An issue-derived prompt defaults to a reviewable draft; other prompts keep the session default.

model.description: Model passed to the public quirky.session/create API; requires agent and public launch preflight.

options.description: String or boolean agent option picks passed to quirky.session/create and validated by quirky.agents/resolveLaunch before the worktree is created.

sparsePaths.description: Tracked repository-relative files or directories to materialize with Git sparse checkout. Unsafe, missing or invalid paths fail before worktree creation.

keepMain.description: Fast-forward the primary checkout only when it is clean, on the exact selected remote-tracking branch, and strictly behind that base. Never resets or falls back to a local base.

environmentRecipe.description: Selected environmentRecipes.id. Provisions a genuine Lima VM and attaches its owner-bound guest workspace; requires the exact lifecycle hash and an available backend.

trustEnvironmentRecipeHash.description: Exact full environment recipe hash from vm-recipes, approving this one provisioning operation.

defaultTabs.description: One-based indexes into the selected commit's defaultTabs list; omitted selects every configured tab. Invalid indexes fail before worktree creation.

allowLocalBaseFallback.description: Use the local branch when a remote base cannot be fetched (default true).

activate.description: Open the new worktree in the window.

window.description: Exact live UI connection to activate when activate is true.

createdBy.description: The surface creating the workspace; defaults to api.
